Rank 4 Ki Technique

  • Ki Cost: Special
  • Prerequisites: None
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: Self (150 foot line)
  • Chargeable?: Yes
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Type: Beam

A very powerful move that resembles a drill. Targets in range must make a Dexterity Saving Throw or take X sets of 2d10 Ki Damage on a hit, where X is for how many sets of 15 Ki you expend during the casting of this Technique, Half on a save.

The maximum Damage Dice Amount, before charging is calculated, can not exceed 3x your total Character Level.
